title: How to automate WhatsApp Business with your AI agent and Zapier
summary: A customer messages your WhatsApp Business number. Your AI assistant could help you word the perfect reply, but when the chat closes, the lead still has to be logged in your CRM, the ticket still has to be opened, and the confirmation still has to go out. Now you can set those follow-ups up from the AI tool you already use.
